description: This Java source file defines a servlet class 'AddAdmin' used in a web application for processing admin registration form submissions. It handles extracting form data, invoking database utility methods to add an admin, and controlling the response flow based on success or failure.

classes.name: AddAdmin
classes.description: Servlet class handling the addition of new admin users via form submission, including image upload handling.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to process admin registration data, including invoking image upload, database insertion, and redirecting or forwarding based on success.
